correctness.rationale: For invertible dissipative A with sigma_min(A)>=1/2 set B=A^-1, N=B²-B, D=B²-2B+2I. Verify the exact ORDERED noncommutative identity D*D-N*N=(4I-B*B)+(B-2I)*[-(B+B*)](B-2I)>=0, using ||B||<=2 and B+B*<=0. D is invertible because B has left-half-plane spectrum, establishing R(A)=ND^-1 contractive; strict dissipativity gives positive definiteness. In mass-weighted physical coordinates, each polarized relative generator is G^(1/2)diag(-alpha_i +/- i Omega_i)G^(1/2), where G=I+ss*>=I, so its least singular value exceeds rmin, Hermitian part is negative definite. The center-of-mass direction is fixed and relative components contract; longitudinal real drag also contracts. Scalar imaginary arguments just below 1/2 amplify, and a positive-drag rational one-species witness realizes this physically. Independent random nonnormal SOS matrices, positive-drag mass-weighted sources and the exact rational witness corroborated; no claim for nonlinear state updates.
